headline: When Does UCSB Start? Fall Quarter 2026 Dates, Explained
description: UCSB Fall Quarter 2026 begins Sunday, September 20, and instruction starts Thursday, September 24. Key dates, finals week, and what to do before day one.

mainEntity.name: When does UCSB start in Fall 2026?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fall Quarter 2026 officially begins Sunday, September 20, 2026, and instruction begins Thursday, September 24, 2026.

mainEntity.name: Why does UCSB start classes on a Thursday?

acceptedAnswer.text: UCSB's fall calendar opens with pre-instruction days early in the week for orientation and settling in, so the first day of class lands on a Thursday.

mainEntity.name: When is UCSB's Fall 2026 finals week?

acceptedAnswer.text: Instruction ends Friday, December 4, 2026, and final exams run Saturday, December 5 through Friday, December 11, 2026.
